name: ESP32-C3

reserved.12-17: Wired to the flash chip. Using them crashes the board.

avoid.2: Strapping pin. Must be high at reset for a normal boot.
avoid.8: Strapping pin. Must be high at reset to flash the board.
avoid.9: Strapping pin, usually the BOOT button. Held low at reset, the board starts in download mode.
avoid.18-19: Native USB D- and D+. On boards that use native USB for serial, using them cuts the link to Thingstudio.
avoid.20-21: UART0 RX and TX. On boards with a USB-serial chip, these carry the link to Thingstudio.

notes: ESP32-C3 (single-core RISC-V). Has one SPI bus (1) and one I2C bus (0) for user code.
